blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III on Tuesday convened for its fourth status conference concerning the charges of crimes against humanity against former President Rodrigo Duterte. Today’s agenda will focus on the trial proper’s daily sitting schedule through Nov. 30, including the trial’s opening statements and first evidentiary block in December 2026. Judges will also hear submissions on the prosecution’s list of witnesses and decide on the number of hours they will have to present the case.
